name: Ashihara Kyouko
source:
Upon entering high school, she joined the literary arts club. Kyouko met [url=https://vndb.org/c4700]Ryou[/url] when she joined, and it was love-at-first-sight. Usually, Kyouko seems a bit out in left field and doesn't show how she really feels. Being taller than most girls, she feels awkward about her height.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/crescendo.html]JAST USA[/url]]
